text:
claire: Quick sync  we need a tight benchmark narrative for launch: 3 visuals, two headline tones, a 1-line sales calc, and routing rules. Can we keep runs tiny?
harry: yes. slices: short-chat, long-agent, embeddings. 2 seeds each, <=3k tokens per slice.
mina: Visuals: A) scatter: median latency vs $/1k tokens, B) percentile ladder (p50..p99) for short vs long, C) stacked bars showing cache+batch impact per-slice.
claire: copy directions: Tone 1 (engineer): "Bench-backed serving: predictable tails and unit economics." Tone 2 (customer): "Faster answers, lower inference bills." Keep hero conservative ("up to").
harry: sales calc one-liner: "Baseline: $0.00045/token => $450 per 1M. Typical cache+batch -> ~45% lower => ~$250 per 1M."
mina: inbound routing bullets: tag 'bench' on prompt upload; demo route if monthly tokens > 10M or requests private deploy; webinar RSVPs get CSV + 1-page cheat.
claire: chart specs (minimal):
- A: x=median ms, y=$/1k tokens, points=model variants, annotate p95
- B: percentiles 50..99, lines=short,long
- C: rows=short,long,embed bars=baseline vs cache vs batch+quant, metric=$/req
harry: bench-run example to share: `/bench quick --model rwd-small --slices short,long,embed --tokens 3000 --seeds 2 --out ./bench`
dev-bot: queued 3 quick runs. ETA ~25m. outputs: CSV + 3 PNGs + summary.txt. use `/bench status` to follow.
mina: timeline: mock PNGs by EOD today, copy Wed AM, webinar Thu. keep deliverables copy <=2 lines each.
claire: thanks all. drop artifacts here and I'll stitch landing + routing playbook.
